name: @devtools/overlay
description: In-browser DevTools overlay: Shadow DOM host, element inspector, and gateway chat

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gateway/shared-types build && vite build && vite build --mode iife && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @gateway/shared-types build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
